add.k: A bookie who drowns late payers in her pool
st: Bookie Sal Blaskowski has Erik dropped in her pool for paying late, then is impaled on her own crowbar fighting a masked vigilante.

files.notes: Named in dialogue (Sal, Sal Blaskowski) in S3E4. Her crew (son Dwayne and his men) is never named as a group, so Independent. Ends hospitalized and stabilized, not arrested, so Active.

add.k: Antoine's sister, an administrator at the MTA
st: Serena Grier trades Luke the name of Reva's drunk bus driver once Jessica brings her missing brother Antoine home.

files.notes: Name said in S1E6 (Luke: 'Her name's Serena'; Jessica: 'Serena Grier?'). Luke says 'Serena was an administrator' at the MTA; group name MTA is from dialogue, not in groups_in_app.

st: Inmate Sissy takes Hope's cash and cigarettes to beat her bloody, then is slammed into a vending machine by Jessica.

files.notes: 'Sissy' said in S1E5, 'Sissy Garcia' in S1E6 (Jeri). Filed A: she beats Hope at Hope's own paid request rather than working against the heroes; T would also be defensible. Prison inmate is not a group, so Independent.

st: Sonia fights Oscar for custody of Vido and flees with him on a bus to Montreal, but gives up when the bus is stopped.

files.notes: Named in dialogue S2E4 and S2E9. No group named on screen.

add.k: A name partner at Jeri's law firm
st: Benowitz helps push Jeri out of the firm, but Malcolm learns his secrets and Jeri's tape of Chao forces a doubled severance.
Out and happier, Benowitz visits Jeri's new firm to tell her he and Chao are poaching Rand Enterprises from her.

files.notes: 'Benowitz' said as a person from S2E3 (firm name said in S1E4); 'Steven' said S2E13, 'Steven Benowitz' S3E6. Filed A: a corporate rival of Jeri, not a threat. Wiki lists his S3 appearance as JJ305 but the scene is in S3E6 per transcript.

add.k: A bartender planning his own club, Club Alias
st: Bartender Stirling quits, dates Jessica, and agrees to sell her muscle to Wyatt to clear his debt before Alisa kills him.

files.notes: Only 'Stirling' is said (S2E7); surname Adams never said, so n is Stirling. The bar he quits is never named on screen and Club Alias never opens, so Independent.

add.k: An accountant hiding photos of young girls
st: Todd White pays Erik's blackmail note, then is exposed by Jessica as a predator and locked in his closet for the police.

files.notes: Name said in S3E4 ('Mark number one, Todd White'). Status In custody inferred: Jessica locks him in with the evidence and calls 911; the arrest itself is not shown.

st: Wendy fights Jeri's divorce for 70% of everything, until Kilgrave makes her cut Jeri and Pam kills her with a blow.

files.notes: On screen from S1E1 unnamed; 'Wendy' first said in S1E4 (her S1E3 clinic scene names her only in subtitle tags). Ross-Hogarth is never said in the transcripts, so n is Wendy and the id keeps the wiki name. Her clinic's name could not be confirmed on screen, so Independent.

add.k: A frightened speedster made by IGH
st: Whizzer begs Jessica to protect him, flees her office at super speed, and is crushed by falling scaffolding.

files.notes: 'Whizzer' said S2E1, 'Robert Coleman' said S2E2. Later on screen only in his recorded videos (S2E2, S2E3). IGH experimented on him (victim, not a member), so Independent.

add.k: A thug who invested in Stirling's club
st: Wyatt roughs up Stirling over his debt, is beaten by Jessica, then buys her muscle and is arrested for Stirling's murder.

files.notes: Name said S2E7 ('Jess, this is Wyatt'). His 'other business' is never named, so Independent. Arrest is reported in dialogue ('The cops arrested those guys').

st: Lawyer Zaya dates Malcolm, edits footage to hide him letting the masked vigilante go, and leaves when she finds Brianna there.

stages.title: Jessica Jones S3
stages.text: Erik borrows from Sal and keeps paying late, so she has him weighted and dropped in her pool. Three hours late again, he is thrown back in until the masked vigilante attacks.
stages.whoA: A gambler who always pays late
stages.whoB: His bookie, who drowns late payers

stages.title: Jessica Jones S3
stages.text: Masked, Trish storms Sal's house to pull Erik out of the pool. Sal swings a crowbar at her and ends up impaled on it, and Trish apologizes as she flees.
stages.whoA: The masked vigilante who crashed her house
stages.whoB: A bookie impaled during a rescue

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Serena asks Luke to find her missing brother Antoine in exchange for the file on the crash that killed Reva. When Antoine is home, she hands Luke the name Charles Wallace.
stages.whoA: Found her brother in exchange for the bus file
stages.whoB: Traded him the name of Reva's bus driver

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Jessica brings Antoine home to Serena and demands what she promised Luke. Once Luke leaves with the driver's name, Jessica tells Serena he is going to kill that man.
stages.whoA: The P.I. who brought her brother home
stages.whoB: Antoine's sister, Luke's client

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Cellmates Sissy and Hope watch their prison TV show together. Hope pays Sissy fifty bucks and a pack of smokes to beat her, and Sissy nearly kills her.
stages.whoA: Her cellmate, who paid for a beating
stages.whoB: Her cellmate, paid to beat her

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Jessica visits Sissy in prison after Hope's beating and slams her into a vending machine. Sissy admits she only did what Hope paid her to do.
stages.whoA: The visitor who slammed her into a machine
stages.whoB: Hope's cellmate and attacker

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Sonia and her ex-husband Oscar fight over custody of their son Vido. When she leaves with Vido and suitcases, Oscar tracks her to the bus station with Jessica.
stages.whoA: Her ex-husband, Vido's father
stages.whoB: His ex-wife, Vido's mother

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Sonia drags Vido home after finding him hanging from Jessica's window. Later she takes him onto a bus to Montreal, then agrees to stay.
stages.whoA: Her son
stages.whoB: His mother

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Sonia distrusts Jessica after seeing Vido dangling from her window. Jessica helps Oscar track Sonia to the bus station and stop her leaving with Vido.
stages.whoA: The neighbor she doesn't trust near Vido
stages.whoB: Vido's mother

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Benowitz and Chao use Jeri's scandal and her illness to push her out of the firm. Jeri digs for dirt and uses a tape of Chao laundering money to double her severance, promising not to out Steven.
stages.whoA: His name partner, pushed out of the firm
stages.whoB: A name partner pushing her out

stages.title: Jessica Jones S3
stages.text: Benowitz delivers client transfer papers to Jeri's new firm in person, taking Rand Enterprises. He thanks her for telling him to come out and urges her to slow down.
stages.whoA: His old partner, now a rival firm
stages.whoB: Her old partner, poaching her clients

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Malcolm finds Benowitz at a Chelsea bar and, instead of blackmailing him, tells him to go home and tell his wife the truth. Jeri later reveals Malcolm was working for her.
stages.whoA: Jeri's investigator who trailed him
stages.whoB: Jeri's partner he trailed to a bar

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Stirling meets Jessica at his bar, quits with a bottle of whiskey, and they start dating. He agrees to lend her muscle to Wyatt, and she finds him dead in an alley.
stages.whoA: His girlfriend
stages.whoB: Her boyfriend, who dreamed of Club Alias

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Wyatt invested in Stirling's Club Alias and comes for his money until Jessica beats him and his men. He then offers to forgive the debt for Jessica as muscle, and Stirling agrees for a cut.
stages.whoA: The investor demanding his money back
stages.whoB: The bartender who owes him

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Alisa overhears Stirling selling Jessica's muscle to Wyatt and confronts him outside. Calling herself Jessica's mother, she beats him to death against a wall.
stages.whoA: Jessica's mother, his killer
stages.whoB: Jessica's boyfriend, whom she killed

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Wyatt shoves Stirling around over his debt until Jessica throws him and his men out. Wanting her strength for his jobs, he cuts a deal with Stirling, but the cops arrest him after Stirling's death.
stages.whoA: Stirling's girlfriend, who beat his crew
stages.whoB: Stirling's investor, who wanted her as muscle

stages.title: Jessica Jones S3
stages.text: Jessica and Erik pose as couriers to ask Todd why he paid a blackmail note. She finds his photos of young girls, locks him in a closet and calls the police.
stages.whoA: The P.I. who exposed him
stages.whoB: A blackmail mark, exposed as a predator

stages.title: Jessica Jones S3
stages.text: Todd is the first mark on Erik's blackmail list, and he paid. Erik comes to his door with Jessica to learn whether Todd tried to kill him.
stages.whoA: The blackmailer who targeted him
stages.whoB: Mark number one on his list

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Wendy learns of Jeri's affair with Pam and fights the divorce for 70% of everything. Enthralled by Kilgrave, she tries to kill Jeri with a thousand cuts until Pam strikes her dead.
stages.whoA: Her wife, divorcing her for Pam
stages.whoB: Her wife, killed by Pam

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Jeri brings a wounded Kilgrave to Wendy's home, and he orders her to treat him. Before fleeing, he tells her to kill Jeri with a thousand cuts.
stages.whoA: The man who took over her mind
stages.whoB: Jeri's wife, ordered to kill her

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Jessica asks Wendy for Sufentanil and gets an anti-psychotic prescription instead. Later, for Jeri, she dangles Wendy over the subway tracks to make her sign the divorce papers.
stages.whoA: Jeri's P.I., who threatened her
stages.whoB: Jeri's wife, a doctor

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Whizzer begs Jessica to protect him from something hunting him, and she brushes him off. When he pulls a gun and flees at super speed, she chases him and finds him dead under scaffolding.
stages.whoA: The P.I. he begged for protection
stages.whoB: A speedster who begged for her help

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Something strong and fast hunts Whizzer through the city. Alisa catches up with him and brings scaffolding down on him.
stages.whoA: The killer who hunted him
stages.whoB: A speedster she killed

stages.title: Jessica Jones S3
stages.text: Zaya and Malcolm date and work together at Hogarth & Associates. She edits the footage of him letting the masked vigilante go, but he pulls away, and she leaves when she finds Brianna at his place.
stages.whoA: Her boyfriend and fellow associate
stages.whoB: His girlfriend, a lawyer at Jeri's firm

stages.title: Jessica Jones S3
stages.text: Zaya works under Jeri and calls her the best mentor. Jeri sets her on the masked vigilante's trail, and Zaya edits the security footage to hide Malcolm's part.
stages.whoA: Her boss and mentor
stages.whoB: A lawyer at her firm

dropped.why: Her name is never said in any Jessica Jones transcript (S1 to S3), and the wiki cites no on-screen source for it; she is credited as 'Bartender' in one episode, so the name comes only from credits.

changes.why: The stage names Alisa as Whizzer's killer, but in S2E1 the killer is unseen and the name Alisa is first said in S2E7 (S2E1 to S2E6 never say it), so the stage sits at the reveal to stay spoiler-safe.
